title: GNOME libxml2 2.14.0 through 2.15.4 contains a missing NUL termination flaw in xmlBufferAddHead() in buf.c that leaves…
description: GNOME libxml2 versions 2.14.0 through 2.15.4 have a vulnerability in the xmlBufferAddHead() function where a missing NUL termination leads to uninitialized heap bytes being used as terminators for storage-less buffers. This flaw can cause over-reads when applications reuse an xmlBuffer and invoke xmlBufferCat() or xmlStrlen(), potentially disclosing adjacent heap memory or causing application crashes.
